items.title: California’s proposed ‘billionaire tax’ fails to pass
items.title_cn: 加州提议的“亿万富翁税”未能通过
items.summary: California voters rejected Proposition 40, the one-time 5% tax on billionaires, the AP reported Monday. Tech leaders outspent backers roughly 10 to 1 to defeat it, and the founders and economists TechCrunch interviewed before the vote were split on whether it would have driven out wealthy residents or just trimmed their fortunes.
items.summary_cn: 据美联社周一报道，加州选民否决了 40 号提案，即对亿万富翁一次性征收 5% 的税。科技领袖们以大约 10 比 1 的比例击败了支持者，投票前接受 TechCrunch 采访的创始人和经济学家对于该法案是否会赶走富裕居民或只是削减他们的财富存在分歧。
items.comment: 行业变化快，今天的热点明天可能就凉了，理性看待。
